entities.summary: Blaise Yepmou Mendouo is a Cameroonian-French boxer. He competed in the super heavyweight event at the 2012 Summer Olympics and was eliminated in the round of 16 by Mohamed Arjaoui of Morocco. After his defeat, he was one of seven Cameroonian athletes who disappeared from the Olympic Village.
